title: Scylla Monitoring Stack configuration
description: The configuration file applied by scylla_monitoring_config.py, version 1. The file holds the complete configuration and every write replaces it whole. Fields the watcher does not know are ignored; with --strict they reject the file. Objects whose keys are free (labels, grafana.env, systemd, alert_rules, alertmanager_config) say so with their own additionalProperties. scylla-monitoring.example.yaml is a complete example.

version.description: The schema version. Renamed or removed fields, or a changed meaning, bump it; new optional fields keep it.

generation.description: Set by the writer, any string. The watcher reports it back as is in the status file.

cluster.description: The cluster label on the prometheus and grafana jobs, which scrape the monitoring stack itself, and Prometheus's cluster external label, which identifies the monitor to Thanos. Set it only when the monitor serves one cluster, to the cluster label of its targets.

scylla_version.description: The ScyllaDB version of the dashboards (start-all.sh -v).

manager_version.description: The Scylla Manager version of the dashboards (start-all.sh -M). Missing: the default manager version of the release.

log_collector.description: The log collector (start-all.sh --log-collector). none runs no Loki either.

thanos_sidecar.description: Run the Thanos sidecar next to Prometheus (start-all.sh --thanos-sc). Needs storage.prometheus_dir.

local_thanos.description: Run a local Thanos query in front of Prometheus (start-all.sh --local-thanos).

bind_address.description: The address the containers' ports are published on (start-all.sh -A). Set it to 127.0.0.1 when tls.enabled is true, so traefik is the only way in.

extra_flags.description: start-all.sh flags, in start-all.sh syntax. A flag here takes precedence over the same option derived from the rest of the file.

storage.description: Data directories on the host. A missing directory keeps the data inside the container, and it is lost when the container is removed.

external_url.description: The URL Prometheus is reached at (start-all.sh -b --web.external-url, with --web.route-prefix=/).

root_url.description: The URL Grafana is reached at (GF_SERVER_ROOT_URL).

env.description: Any other Grafana setting, as GF_* environment variables (start-all.sh -c).

admin_password.description: The Grafana admin password (GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD). A change is applied to the running Grafana.

scylla.description: The ScyllaDB nodes, as hosts without a port. Written as scylla_servers.yml, node_exporter_servers.yml and scylla_manager_agents.yml; each job adds its own port (9180, 9100, 5090).

node_exporter.description: node_exporter targets, written as node_exporter_servers.yml in place of the copy of scylla. A target keeps its port; 9100 is added to one without. instance is the address without its port; an entry whose address differs from its ScyllaDB node sets instance in its labels.

vector_search.description: Vector search nodes (vector_search_servers.yml). Present: start-all.sh --vector-search, which adds the vector search dashboards.

alert_rules.description: A Prometheus rule file, checked with promtool check rules.

alertmanager_config.description: An Alertmanager config file, checked with amtool check-config.

systemd.description: systemd drop-ins for host services, by unit name. Each value is the content of /etc/systemd/system/<unit>.d/50-scylla-monitoring.conf; a changed drop-in restarts its unit, and a unit removed from here has its drop-in removed and is restarted. docker.service and the watcher's own unit are refused.

tls.description: The traefik mTLS proxy in front of the stack. Missing or enabled false: no traefik.

listen_ip.description: The host address traefik listens on (PRIVATE_IP of start-traefik.sh).

ca_crt.description: PEM. Clients must present a certificate signed by it (rootCA.crt).

server_crt.description: PEM. traefik's certificate (server.crt). It also needs client auth and listen_ip as an IP SAN, for the readiness probe.
